definitions.cycle_share: class Max list USD in a complete weekly cycle / that cycle's USD per 1 %
definitions.lapsed_pct: 100 - the cycle's peak 7-day reading (usage the window could have carried but did not)
definitions.max_pct: Max list USD per week / (list USD per 1 % of the weekly window); median uses the median cycle value, low/high use the dearest/cheapest cycle
definitions.projected_demand_pct: cycle peak + weekly Max delta of the design, scaled to the cycle length; may exceed 100 (= demand the guard must defer or flip to IU)
definitions.weekly: window total x 7 / days covered; OpenCode-collected agw rows exclude the v1->v2 collector gap

notes: Max rows are list-price equivalents (sunk subscription); IU rows are cash.
Mother/lead load is an assumption set, not a measurement: no mother runs yet (report/05-decisions.md).
Today's cycle % is the measured 7-day peak by construction ($/1 % is calibrated on the same cycles).
A cycle's peak is censored at 100 %: where it hit 100, true demand was higher, so design demand and overflow there are lower bounds.
recent_7d is a calendar 7 days spanning two resets (10-17 unscheduled, 10-21 scheduled); it is a burn-rate signal, not a window reading.
claude-code agent-gateway:dispatch on IU stopped 2026-09-24; it inflates the 30 d IU rate versus recent_7d.
